import narwhals as nw

# Scan the parquet file lazily with polars backend
lazy_df = nw.scan_parquet("events.parquet")

# Build the lazy pipeline: filter, select, then materialize
result = (
    lazy_df
    .filter(nw.col("status") == "ok")
    .select(["user", "duration"])
    .collect()
)

print(result)
